name: print-social-language-hack-post-with-retro-laptop-and-pixel-badges
title: Mustard 'life hack' post with a retro laptop screen, pill titles, pink starbursts and pixel icons
whatItIs: A grainy mustard post with big pink starbursts outlined in blue and yellow, a lavender pill title in fat display letters, a dark green pill subtitle, pixel gamepad and heart, and a lilac retro laptop whose blue screen shows word equivalents in monospace, decorated with sparkles, mushrooms and a rainbow.
whatItMeans: Playful and nostalgic; the retro laptop makes vocabulary tricks feel like a game.
techniques: Show the lesson on a drawn retro laptop screen.
Stack pill titles in two colours.
Add pixel icons and sticker doodles.

vocabulary.definition: A flat illustration of an old computer.
A headline inside a rounded capsule.
Content shown on an illustrated screen.
